title: Limit state of collapse: shear
verified_by: Rounaq, manual check against page_085.png and page_086.png

items.text: under no circumstances, even with shear reinforcement, shall tau_v exceed tau_c_max given in Table 20
when tau_v is less than tau_c given in Table 19, minimum shear reinforcement shall be provided in accordance with 26.5.1.6
when tau_v exceeds tau_c, shear reinforcement shall be provided to carry a shear equal to Vu - tau_c*b*d
vertical stirrups: Vus = 0.87*fy*Asv*d/sv; fy of the stirrups shall not be taken greater than 415 N/mm2
inclined stirrups, bent-up bars, slabs (40.2.1.1), axial compression (40.2.2), beams of varying depth (40.1.1), enhanced shear near supports (40.5)

notes: I confirm I compared these with the page images.
